artifacts.summary: Implementation summary covering all 6 phases: build fixture, exclusions, registry-driven inclusions, wheel/sdist parity, entry-point assertion, and CI wiring

completion_data.completion_summary: Added an executable code/tests/packaging/ suite (108 tests under the new packaging pytest marker) that builds fresh wheel/sdist artifacts and asserts exclusions, registry-driven inclusions, wheel/sdist parity, and console-script installability, then wired a push/PR-triggered packaging.yml workflow plus an additive packaging-test step in release.yml's build job so the suite actually runs in CI. Post-hoc: the plan's deliberate-drift smoke check surfaced a stale-build-cache defect (python -m build --no-isolation reused code/build/ and src/model_checker.egg-info/ incrementally, causing a false pass); fixed by clearing both before/after every session build. Re-verified the smoke check now correctly detects drift.

next_steps: Task complete. No further action required.
